description: Use this when the user wants one paper in depth: what it did and found, in which species and how many subjects, its caveats, who wrote it and where they work. Takes a paper id such as MED-42823970 from another tool's results. Returns how it bears on aging, the language it was published in with its own-language title when that is not English, every author with ORCID iD and institutions, its full story (headline, body, why it matters, caveats) when published, the drugs, genes and processes it studies and its findings, and a link to the paper at its source. It does not replace the paper.
name: get_paper
